title: Memoising LRU Cache: Bug Fix and Durability
summary: Fix three bugs in a functools.lru_cache-style memoising wrapper, centred on how positional and keyword arguments turn into a cache key; then make the cache survive a process crash with an append-only log and periodic snapshotting; then make it thread-safe, with single-flight so concurrent callers never compute the same missing key twice.
